title: ModelDescriptor
description: Schema for an LLM model descriptor used by an agent for model selection.

model_name.description: Unique identifier / slug for the model.

specifications.description: Static technical characteristics of the model.

context_window.description: Maximum number of tokens the model can process in a single request (prompt + completion).

relative_speed_rating.description: Ordinal speed score relative to other models in the registry. Higher is faster.

reasoning.description: Whether the model exposes an explicit chain-of-thought / reasoning trace.

provider.description: Organisation that develops and hosts the model.

release_date.description: ISO 8601 calendar date on which the model was publicly released.

optimal_configuration.description: Recommended inference parameters for typical production use.

max_tokens.description: Default ceiling on completion length in tokens.

min.description: Lower bound of the acceptable temperature range.

max.description: Upper bound of the acceptable temperature range.

recommended.description: Single recommended temperature value within [min, max].

rationale.description: Human-readable explanation for the recommended temperature.

usage_guidelines.description: Qualitative guidance on where the model excels and where it falls short.

strengths.description: Task categories or conditions where this model is the preferred choice.

weaknesses.description: Task categories or conditions where a different model should be preferred.

management_summary.description: Concise plain-English deployment guidance covering when to select this model versus alternatives.
